0022600033.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-7, 0-3 at home, coming off a loss) host the San Antonio Spurs (6-2, on a six-game winning streak) in the Kings' ninth game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup West Group C matchup. Sacramento sits 15th in the West and 5th in the Pacific, 5.5 games back, while San Antonio is 6th in the West and 2nd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, and has won 2 of 2 on the road. Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee) are out for the Kings, and De'Andre Hunter is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision, while Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain) are out for the Spurs. The Kings trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 130-103 in San Antonio on October 27, and they lost all three meetings to the Spurs in 2025-26.
